LanguageData.DMS_SolitaryZPM.label: solidified zero-point energy
LanguageData.DMS_SolitaryZPM.description: Physical energy solidified into a stable material state by a confinement field - one of the transcendent technologies whose working principles humanity has managed to decipher, and the power source of most transcendent artifacts. Most existing human technology, however, cannot make direct use of the energy inside it.
